summary: Tested Email Features API (Templates & Signatures CRUD) for Marketing Operations Platform Phase 1 Mail Inbox Features. All 26 backend tests passed 100%. Templates and Signatures are correctly stored per-user in MongoDB collections (email_templates, email_signatures) with proper CRUD operations and is_default flag behavior.

TestEmailTemplatesCRUD.test_create_template_success: PASS - POST creates template with all fields
TestEmailTemplatesCRUD.test_create_template_and_verify_persiste: PASS - Created template persists in DB

TestEmailSignaturesCRUD.test_create_default_signature_unsets_oth: PASS - Setting is_default=true unsets other signatures
TestEmailSignaturesCRUD.test_update_signature_to_default_unsets_: PASS - Updating to default unsets others

features_verified: 1. Email Templates CRUD API - GET /api/email-features/templates - returns user's templates
2. Email Templates CRUD API - POST /api/email-features/templates - creates new template
3. Email Templates CRUD API - PUT /api/email-features/templates/{id} - updates template
4. Email Templates CRUD API - DELETE /api/email-features/templates/{id} - deletes template
5. Email Signatures CRUD API - GET /api/email-features/signatures - returns user's signatures
6. Email Signatures CRUD API - POST /api/email-features/signatures - creates new signature
7. Email Signatures CRUD API - PUT /api/email-features/signatures/{id} - updates signature
8. Email Signatures CRUD API - DELETE /api/email-features/signatures/{id} - deletes signature
9. Setting is_default=true on new signature correctly unsets other signatures' default flag
10. Updating existing signature to is_default=true correctly unsets other signatures' default flag
11. Templates stored per-user in MongoDB (email_templates collection)
12. Signatures stored per-user in MongoDB (email_signatures collection)
14. Default category is 'general' when not specified
15. Complex HTML content preserved in signatures
16. All endpoints require authentication (return 401/403 without token)
17. Input validation returns 422 for missing required fields
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email Features API for Templates and Signatures is fully functional. Backend uses MongoDB collections email_templates and email_signatures with user_id based isolation. The is_default flag behavior for signatures correctly unsets other signatures when a new default is set. Frontend integration (EmailPage.jsx) calls fetchTemplates(), fetchSignatures(), createTemplate(), updateTemplate(), deleteTemplate(), createSignature(), updateSignature(), deleteSignature() - all using the /api/email-features/* endpoints. Note: Frontend cannot be screenshot tested due to Microsoft OAuth requirement for the mail page.
